ValidationRule.description: If Deviation 2 type = Credit Other then the agent has to fill Other Deviation 2 type manually.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Deviation_2_type__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Deviation_2_type__c, "Credit - Other"), ISBLANK(cc_Other_Deviation_2_type__c), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Other Deviation 2 type manually.
